item.title: ‘Wicked: For Good’ Gets Some Love at 2026 ASCAP Screen Celebrates Event
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the music industry. Today, we're talking about the recent ASCAP Screen Celebrates event in Los Angeles, where some of the biggest names in film and television music were honored. I'm your host, and let's get started!
[Slightly upbeat background music continues]
Host: "You might remember the film Wicked: For Good, which grossed a whopping $540 million worldwide. Despite facing some unexpected criticism, the film's score, composed by John Powell and Stephen Schwartz, just won the 2026 ASCAP Composers' Choice Award for Film Score of the Year. This award is particularly notable because it's chosen by the ASCAP composer and songwriter community themselves.
[Soft music transition]
Host: "But that's not all - the ASCAP Composers' Choice Awards also recognized other outstanding scores in film, television, and video games. Some of the winners include Jeff Toyne for Television Score of the Year for Palm Royale, and Wilbert Roget II, Jon Everist, and Cody Matthew Johnson for Video Game Score of the Year for Star Wars Outlaws: A Pirate's Fortune.
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: "The ASCAP Screen Music Awards were also presented at the event, celebrating composers who elevate the art of visual storytelling. Michael Giacchino won Top Domestic Box Office Film of the Year for Zootopia 2, while Jake Staley and John Sereda took home awards for their work in television.
[Music transitions back to a soft tone]
Host: "And in a special recognition, David Vanacore was presented with ASCAP's Golden Note Award for his career achievements and impact on television music. Vanacore has been a pioneering force in unscripted scoring, composing music for CBS's Survivor since its debut in 2000.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's podcast. Congratulations to all the winners, and thanks for tuning in. You can find the complete list of winners on the ASCAP website at ascap.com/screenawards26. We'll see you next time!"
